lines.t: Hi everyone, and welcome to the SpeakLab Podcast. I'm Leyla.
And I'm Sam. Today's topic is goodbyes and reunions. And Leyla — this is our sixtieth episode.
Sixty! The last one of our season. It feels a bit bittersweet.
Happy and sad at the same time. Exactly. And I have news: I'm going home to Manchester next month.
For good?
No, no! Just for two weeks. My sister's party, my mum's cooking, my old running friends.
Will you be homesick for Baku? [laugh]
Honestly? Probably. I'll miss the tea, the sea… and Mr Aliyev's figs.
My school class had a reunion last month. Twenty years after we finished school.
How was it?
Strange and lovely. Some friends I see every week. With others, we started to drift apart after school.
That happens. Life takes people in different directions.
But my best friend from school now lives in Canada. She flew in just for the reunion.
Wow. You must have been so happy.
We cried and laughed all night. Absence makes the heart grow fonder, they say.
When I left Manchester, my mum stood at the airport and waved until she couldn't see me.
And now she calls you every evening.
Every single evening. [chuckle] We really keep in touch.
And that's what we hope you do too — with your SpeakLab partners.
Yes! Don't say farewell after one call. Call them again. Make a friend.
Here's your last question for your next SpeakLab call: who do you miss — and when did you last see them?
Thank you for listening to all sixty episodes. See you next season!
Bye for now!
